## Summary
- key upstream stdio Task Orchestrator state by git repo identity
- make dopemux mcp usable from repos without local mcp_catalog.yaml via bundled defaults
- document Codex and dopemux launch surfaces separately

## Validation

- uv run --extra test pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_commands_catalog.py tests/unit/test_cli_audit_remediations.py
- /Users/hue/plugins/dopemux-mission-control/scripts/task-orchestrator-current-stdio.sh --print-resolution
- git diff --check
